# Set-ZbxAutoregistration

## SYNOPSIS

Changes which connections active agents may autoregister over.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxAutoregistration [-TlsAccept <ZabbixTlsAcceptModes[]>] [-TlsPskIdentity <string>] [-TlsPsk <SecureString>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Set-ZbxAutoregistration cmdlet changes the server's autoregistration settings with autoregistration.update: -TlsAccept sets the connection modes autoregistration accepts, and -TlsPskIdentity with -TlsPsk the pre-shared key an agent must present. A setting not given keeps its value. The command writes the settings only with -PassThru, -WhatIf shows what would change, and it needs a Super admin's connection.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Accept only unencrypted autoregistration

```powershell
Set-ZbxAutoregistration -TlsAccept Unencrypted -PassThru
```

-PassThru writes the settings as the server holds them after the change.

### Example 2: Preview accepting PSK autoregistration

```powershell
Set-ZbxAutoregistration -TlsAccept Unencrypted, Psk -TlsPskIdentity 'autoreg' -TlsPsk (ConvertTo-SecureString '1f87b595725ac58dd977beef14b97461' -AsPlainText -Force) -WhatIf
```

Several modes are given as a list and combined into one setting; the agents must then present this identity and key. -WhatIf shows the change and makes none.
